name: gridpulse
description: U.S. power grid mix, retail electricity prices and Henry Hub natural gas prices from the EIA, paid per call via x402.
long_description: GridPulse gives your assistant live U.S. energy market data from the Energy Information Administration: the hourly generation mix and carbon-free share for each grid region, average retail electricity prices by state and sector, and Henry Hub natural gas spot prices. There's no signup or API key. Each call pays $0.01 to $0.02 in USDC via x402 from a small spending wallet you configure, on Base or Algorand.

tools.name: grid_mix
tools.description: Hourly generation mix and carbon-free share for a U.S. grid region ($0.02)

tools.name: retail_electricity_price
tools.description: Retail electricity price by U.S. state and sector ($0.01)
